findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "analyze_lease" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Analyze a caller-provided Luxembourg residential lease PDF or raw text, persist the full user-scoped analysis, and return a compact risk summary. Do not provide…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing, get_inquiry_status · Private data: get_listing, get_listing_truth, analyze_lease, submit_inquiry · Public sink: submit_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing, get_inquiry_status · Private data: get_listing, get_listing_truth, analyze_lease, submit_inquiry · Public sink: submit_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
